Ecology download hardcodes village-001-preference-v1; member final-response download already uses the D release manifest. Resolve every download from the frozen recovery manifest.

No resume/replay; scripts delete output and allow one whole-batch schema repair. A terminal parse failure can discard a lane after many successful calls. Add exact-source bound immutable checkpoint/replay and bounded missing-only repair before full campaign.

quality_gates.ecology: All 24 sessions and judgments, including 12 cross-lineage contamination audits, are required evidence. Ecology metrics do not enter the current usable_village conjunction.

required_order: Finish and freeze D summary/release bytes plus retrievable adapters.
Preserve recipe, membership and gate values.
